intro: Meet the people supporting Rusetat’s travel, migration and client services, from the first enquiry to the digital tools behind your experience.

people.name: Carol
people.bio: Leads Rusetat’s direction and brings its travel, migration and client services together around the people it serves.

people.name: Alettar
people.bio: Helps with enquiries, coordination and the day-to-day administration around client requests.

people.name: Antony
people.bio: Supports client communication, organised records and practical follow-up as enquiries move through the team.

people.name: Alaska
people.bio: Provides legal consultation and helps bring the legal questions around individual migration circumstances into focus.

people.name: TK
people.bio: Develops the software behind Rusetat’s digital experience, with a focus on useful, reliable tools for clients and the team.

roles.title: Visa & migration support
roles.text: Discuss the purpose of your application, the circumstances that matter and the preparation involved. Clear scope and an individual conversation come before a document checklist.

roles.title: Travel & group planning
roles.text: Bring your destination ideas, preferred pace or event goals into the conversation. Explore the itinerary, accommodation and travel arrangements that should shape your brief.

roles.title: Client communication
roles.text: Ask what happens next, what information is needed and how the agreed service will be coordinated. Confirm the right contact for your request before sharing sensitive documents.
